name: Abhishek Mankuskar
bio:
Connected with various companies across pune and Got 15 developers from ellicium to register to devfest other than that connected with some speakers and invited them to submit the sessions.
I have good communication skills as I ha e been organizing and giving sessions in various events including Devfests.

Why i volunteered because I wanted to connect and learn with amazing developers and also help making this event more helpfull to attendees using my connections and resources and learn some more things from my colligue friends from team.

name: Ajit More
bio: I'm a multi disciplinary artist - I provide anchoring, voice over and filmmaking services from the past 7 years. I choose DevFest as it is a promising technical event happening in the city with countless technical aspects and brands involved. It goes in hand with my signature formal style of presentation. Presenting itself as an ideal opportunity to utilise my skills with efficient showmanship on a good magnitude.

bio: I love to be a part of this community and I have been contributing to Devfest from the last 3 years. I would like to try my hand at anchoring this year. I was the host for CCD 2024 as well.

name: Anupam Sharma
bio: I'm a passionate developer with experience in building web and mobile applications. I enjoy contributing to tech communities by sharing knowledge and collaborating on innovative projects. My skills include working with Flutter, Node.js, and AI/ML. I chose to volunteer for DevFest because I believe in fostering a collaborative environment where developers can learn, grow, and create impactful solutions together. I'm also excited to network with like-minded individuals and contribute to the success of this amazing event.

name: Kesar Tank
bio: I am a fourth-year student pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering. I volunteered for DevFest to connect, learn, and contribute to the tech community while growing both personally and professionally.

Looking forward to this year devfest contribution.

name: Om Deshmukh
bio: Hi, my name is Om. I am an aspiring developer and enjoy mobile photography. I joined the Photography team at DevFest 2024 to capture the event’s moments. I volunteered because I love helping the tech community and meeting new people.

name: Paritosh Vaidya
bio:
Tech Lead, Android expert, Google Android Educator

As a passionate Tech Lead with 12+ years of experience, I translate ambitious business ideas into tangible software products. I excel in leading teams, building scalable architectures, and ensuring smooth project delivery from concept to user delight.

I wanted to contribute to this community, use my skills to make this event successful.

name: Rahul Bhausaheb Sonawane
bio: I have been contributing this community since last years devfest23, and the following events. Apart from my computer background I contributed in photography team last years devfest23. Apart from that I also create reels for our Instapage. I want to continue my contribution this year too. Thank you.

name: Sanika Kotgire
bio:
I'm deeply passionate about technology, specializing in cloud computing with certifications in AWS and GCP. As the author of "Soaring Brimstone's Flight," I enjoy sharing insights and empowering others with knowledge. Alongside my writing, I'm a skilled public speaker, capable of breaking down complex concepts into engaging talks. Additionally, I contribute regularly to the tech community through blogging and am a co-founder of the MLSC club at MIT-ADT University. 
Let's connect and explore exciting opportunities together:)

name: Satyam Gondhale
bio:
My technical expertise includes Android app development using Kotlin. I loves Technical writing and conducting workshops. My interests are making meaningful connections, engage people in conversations, community contribution, consistent learning, guiding and helping students and many more. My contribution for devfest includes reaching out to companies for being a community partner or getting a sponsorship, maximise reach of GDG Pune, inviting developers and companies to event as speakers, collaborators etc. 
I choose to volunteer for DevFest as I feel motivated being around and in  connection with all talented and amazing people in community. The best part is networking, a platform to build life long connections & opening doors for next best opportunities in career.

name: Shaikh Sufiyan
bio: I am a passionate full-stack developer who loves turning ideas into impactful solutions. As a contributor to DevFest Pune 2025, I collaborated with the GDG team to build backend APIs and a Nodemailer service for their job portal project. My skills span across software development, backend engineering, and community building. Beyond coding, I find joy in organizing community events that bring tech enthusiasts together, fostering collaboration and learning. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new technologies, networking with like-minded individuals, and sharing knowledge to inspire innovation.

name: Shreya Dhurde
bio:
Shreya Dhurde is a Generative AI Engineer and Software Engineer at Capgemini Pune. She holds a degree in AI & DS (Class of 2024).
She was introduced to GDG Pune in year 2022 via GDSC , that was the first year of volunteering (Community lounge), later she became an active volunteer and started by anchoring in get togethers and at devfest 2023 she was one of the Anchors . 
In 2024 she has voluntered wtm event and currently is in anchoring domain of volunteering.
Shreya finds joy in anchoring, combining her technical expertise with strong communication skills to facilitate engaging conversations. Her passion stems from the freedom to connect with diverse individuals, leveraging her technical background to navigate discussions with ease and enthusiasm.
